mainEntity.name: What makes Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre different from other rehab facilities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Another Road offers a private, home-like setting with a low client-to-staff ratio, ensuring personalized, long-term recovery plans tailored to each individual. We focus on a holistic approach that addresses both the physical and psychological aspects of addiction.

mainEntity.name: What types of addiction does Another Road treat?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide comprehensive addiction treatment for alcohol, opioids, prescription drugs, and other substance dependencies, using evidence-based therapies like CBT, DBT, counseling, and relapse prevention strategies.

mainEntity.name: Is family involvement part of the recovery process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we believe that family support is crucial to long-term recovery. We offer family counseling and education sessions to help loved ones understand addiction and contribute to the healing process.

mainEntity.name: How long is the addiction treatment program?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our programs are flexible and tailored to individual needs, with a focus on long-term recovery rather than a fixed timeline. Each client receives a customized treatment plan based on their progress.

mainEntity.name: What happens after completing the program?

acceptedAnswer.text: We provide comprehensive aftercare support, including relapse prevention strategies, counseling, and ongoing guidance to ensure clients maintain their sobriety and successfully transition back to everyday life.

about_blocks.text: Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre is a premier private addiction treatment facility in Ontario, offering a personalized, holistic approach to overcoming substance abuse. Unlike conventional rehab programs, we provide long-term residential treatment in a home-like setting, ensuring a comfortable and supportive environment for recovery. With a low client-to-staff ratio, we focus on individualized care, addressing both the physical and psychological aspects of addiction through medically supervised detox, Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT), one-on-one and group counseling, relapse prevention strategies, aftercare support, and family counseling. At Another Road, we believe that recovery is a journey, and our evidence-based treatment methods, compassionate team, and tranquil setting make us a top choice for addiction recovery in Ontario. Start your journey to sobriety today with confidential consultation and customized treatment plans at Another Road Addiction Recovery Centre.
